verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Graph view in which each link between notes becomes a line, showing the local neighbourhood of the open note. The graph can also be opened on a collection, tag, query, object type dashboard, or extended search, which scopes it to what the researcher cares about. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of interactive behaviour (clicking or navigating nodes, in-graph filter controls), any space-wide global graph, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
